translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Moo'aaba Asay bazzuwaa biyaa ogiyaan de'iyaa Selaa'a katamaappe yalaga dorssaa orggetuwaa Yerusaalamen de'iyaa biittaa mooddiyaawoo yeddite.
Moo'aaba mac'c'a Asay barenttu de'iyaa golliyaappe gas'an laaletteedda kafotuwaadan, Arnnoona Shaafaa pinniyaa sa'aan laalettana.
Moo'aaba Asay Yihudaa asaa hawaadan yaagana; «Nuuna zorite; suure pirddite; seeta gallassan hintte kuwaa k'ammaadan kuwayite. Yederssettiyaawantta k'osite; bak'ati yeeddawanttakka aatsi immoppite.

Moo'aabappe yedersseeteeddawanttu hintte giddon de'ino; unttuntta d'ayissiyaawanttuppe unttunttu k'osetti attiyaasaa gidite. Unttuntta uk'k'unniyaawanttu wureeddino; bashshay atteeda; unttunttu tuggayiyaawanttukka gadiyaappe d'ayeeddino.

Hewaappe guyyiyaan, itti kaatetuwaa araatay aggena siik'uwaan ek'k'ana; he araatan, Daawita dunkkaaniyaan itti ammanettiyaa daannay uttana. I suuretetsaa koyana; s'illotetsaa ootsanawukka elleellana» yaagana.

Yihudaa Asay hawaadan yaagana; «Moo'aaba gadiyaa Asay ay keenaa otorettintto, nu unttunttu otoruwaabaa siseeddo; unttunttu ayyuwaanne unttunttu shek'aakka siseeddo; shin unttunttu otoruu hada» yaagana.
Hewaa diraw, Moo'aabe yeekko; Asay ubbaykka Moo'aabaw yeekko; K'iirihereesa kataman hintte de'iyaa wode meedda lo"o k'umaa hassayiide yeekkite.

Haseboona shooyk'atuunne Siibima woyniyaa tokkiyaa sa'atuu d'ayeeddino; unttunttoo tashii Yaa'izeera gakkiide, bazzoo zaa'eedda dooretteedda woynnetuwaa kawutetsatuwaa kaappatuu yederssiide d'ayisseeddino; unttunttu aac'aykka zaa'iide, abbaa pinneedda.

Taani Yaa'izeera katamaw yeekkiyaawaadan, Siibima katamaa woynnetookka yeekkay. Haseboonanne El"aale katamatoo, taani ta afotsaan hinttena holssayay. Ayaw gooppe, hintte mitsaa ayifiyaanne hintte booteedda katsaa bollan olaa waasuu denddeedda.

Katsaa ayifiyaan kumeedda shoyk'aappe nashechchaynne hashshu guussay aketeedda. Woynniyaa tokkiyaa saankka mazimurii yes'ettenna. Nashechchan woyniyaa teeraa gum"iyaa sa'aan gum"iyaabay baawa. Taani gum"iyaawanttu ililiya ililssaakka d'ayissaad.
Hewaa diraw, ta wozanay Moo'aabaw, ta garssa asatetsaykka K'iirihereesaw diitsaadan waassee.
Moo'aabe bare d'ok'k'a sa'aa booppenne, c'oo barena daaburssee; k'ay I bare eek'aa golliyaa woossanaw booppekka, hewe Aa ayinne maaddenna.
Med'inaa Goday kasetiide, Moo'aabewaa odeedda k'aalay hewaa.

Shin ha"i Med'inaa Goday hawaadan yaagee; «Konttiraatiyaa oosanchchaa laytsaa payduwaadan, Moo'aaba bonchchuunne Aa c'oratetsay heezzu laytsatuwaa giddon wurana; aan attiyaa asatuukka amareedawanttanne wolk'k'ay bayinnawantta gidanawantta» yaagee.
